name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TLWEGGH15.cancel_prefix_closed
title: An inner-level wide error that cancels on all valid paths cancels on every path sharing a prefix with a valid path
statement: Let J, level secrets S, wide errors W and a level j be given. If J * (prefix product of S along z up to j) * W_{j, z_j} = 0 for every valid path z, then the same holds for every path z that agrees with some valid path z' on all positions i <= j.
